title: Dick Harper falsified personnel records

tellings.quote: He said, "Well, roughly [music] 200 people were involved in the whole Aztec recovery, so I kept 200 personnel records to make sure nobody was ever really an Aztec."

plain: After a reported 1948 UFO crash and recovery near Aztec, New Mexico, a man named Dick Harper, linked to MacDill, an Air Force base, is said to have doctored personnel files so no one could be shown to have been there. The researcher Scott Ramsey says Harper told him that about 200 people took part in the recovery, "so I kept 200 personnel records to make sure nobody was ever really an Aztec." If true, it would explain why paper records of the people involved are so hard to find.
